body:
## Node editor — style pane explorations

Replace the raw class/JSON **textarea** with structured visual controls — **one control system, three CSS channels**, each compiling to its native idiom while the **raw code stays reachable and two-way bound**: edit a control → the class/declaration updates, edit the raw side → the control updates.

**Today** → 2 freeform textareas for 3 frameworks.
**A1** Tailwind — visual controls ⇄ class chips; editable box-model (right margin 24 → `mr-6`, off-scale → `mr-[25px]`).
**B1** MUI — theme-token controls (spacing scale, palette, elevation, breakpoints) + live `sx`.
**C** Inline — box-model + Layout/Appearance controls + synced declaration rows (no toggles).
Every panel now carries a **Typography** section.

Patterns: Figma/Penpot alignment grid · DevTools box-model & declarations · Webflow/Windframe class chips · Tailwind IntelliSense autocomplete + hover-resolve · Framer/MUI token pickers · Tailwind Play / Penpot "panel == output".
